versions.changelog:
Initial release of the add-json-ld skill:

- Guides users in adding structured JSON-LD data for improved SEO, rich snippets, and enhanced crawlability by search engines and LLMs.
- Supports numerous Schema.org node types: WebSite, WebPage, Person, ProfilePage, CollectionPage, SoftwareApplication, BreadcrumbList, Blog, and BlogPosting.
- Includes a workflow to identify required page types and map each to the appropriate schema nodes.
- Emphasizes correct linking with @id, thorough use of Person.sameAs, and best practices for personal sites.
- Instructions are accessible for both static sites and those with templating/build steps.
- Triggers not only on requests for JSON-LD but also when related topics like structured data, SEO metadata, schemas, knowledge graphs, or site discoverability are mentioned.
